Keep the Free Break-Points Away From a Held One

Source: R/restricted.R
pin_held_breakpoints.Rd

Prepares the break-point terms of a restricted fit in which a coefficient of a continuous modelterms7::seg() term with two or more break-points is held. The free break-points are confined to the side of the held position on which they start, with at least min_obs observations between them and it (modelterms7::seg_pin()), and the starting values of their positions are brought inside the interval. The position of a free break-point is kept inside its interval by an infinite objective outside it (pin_infeasible()).

Usage

pin_held_breakpoints(
  spec,
  design,
  beta,
  from = beta,
  min_obs = 2L,
  variant = 1L
)

Arguments

spec

A StatmodSpec() with the coefficient held.

design

Its design, whose state holds the terms that a fit refreshes. The terms in the state are replaced.

beta

The starting coefficients, stacked, with the held value in place.

from

The coefficients of the unrestricted fit, stacked, from which the starting pairs of position and change of slope are taken.

min_obs

The smallest number of observations between a free and a held break-point.

variant

Which unrestricted break-point the held position stands for, counted from the nearest to it: the held position takes the change of slope of that break-point and the free ones keep the other pairs.

Value

A list with beta, the starting coefficients with the free positions inside their intervals, present, a function of the coefficient list of the restricted fit that returns it with the break-points in order, and variants, the number of break-points that the held position can stand for: the number of break-points of the term when one position is held, and one otherwise. A model without such a term is left unchanged.

Details

Two break-points at one position make two columns of the block equal. A free break-point that reaches the held one then has coefficients of the changes of slope that grow without bound in opposite directions, and the relabeling of crossed break-points of modelterms7::term_refresh() writes the held value onto the coefficients of the free one. A restricted fit of this kind was measured at 4006 scoring iterations, without converging, for a statistic that was not the likelihood ratio.

The coefficients of such a term are returned in the order of the positions of the break-points, by present(), and the coefficient labeled as held carries [held] after its name.

See also

statmod_restrict(), which calls it.
